words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) does more than add another sentence. It carries the prior gathering declaration in 56:49-50 into a staged turn, so the universal scene stands first and the addressed subgroup is singled out afterward. The particle can be read as both coordination and rhetorical resumption: the ayah remains tied to the decree, yet it restarts the discourse as direct confrontation. Its fixed, rootless particle shape makes relation rather than event-action the mechanism, and the doubled nasal sound helps the compact opening beat flow into {{ar:إِنَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:innakum}}). Because the word launches a clause whose predicate waits until 56:52, the connector also begins a delayed movement from decree to indictment to consequence.

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:innakum}}) fuses assertion with the addressed plural, making the group grammatically present before the vocative labels arrive. The suffix is the governed subject of the emphatic particle, not an object suffix, so the coming predicate will be said about this addressed you. That predicate is withheld until 56:52, and the scope may be read as extending through the eating and drinking sequence, so the intervening epithets stand between accused subject and consequence. The word also changes the discourse scale: the gathered masses of 56:49-50 become a second-person group, then {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) names that group by quality. Its doubled assertion and bound suffix compress force and address into one word.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلضَّآلُّونَ}} ({{tr:al-ḍāllūna}}) is the first class label after the vocative carrier. Its nominative, definite, masculine plural participle shape locks it to {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}), so the word identifies the addressed group rather than adding a loose comment. The local {{ar:ض ل ل}} ({{tr:ḍ-l-l}}) sense is straying from guidance and aim, while the wider root images of being lost, disappearing, or failing in memory sharpen the sense of disorientation without replacing that local branch. Because it is Form I active participle, it names an ongoing state and does not turn the group into agents who mislead others. The word also comes first in the double epithet: inward lost orientation is named before outward denial, and the same label returns in same-surah fate language (56:92) while also recalling the warned-against class in 1:7. Its long vowel and doubled consonant make that first identity label audibly heavy before the sharper second charge follows.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mukadhdhibūna}}) is the second definite masculine plural participle in the vocative stack, attached by agreement to the same addressed group as {{ar:ٱلضَّآلُّونَ}} ({{tr:al-ḍāllūna}}). The local {{ar:ك ذ ب}} ({{tr:k-dh-b}}) branch is not simple lying, being denied, or proving someone false; the Form II active participle names people who meet a truth claim by declaring it false. Its active participial shape makes denial an address-time identity, and the doubled middle radical gives that systematic falsification both morphological and audible force. Since it closes the ayah, the line lands on active denial, then 56:52 turns the named identity toward its consequence. The same root and class label continue inside the surah's denial thread, including 56:82 and the changed-case reprise at 56:92.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The direct address joins two plural active-participle labels in sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first label marks departure from a guiding course; the second adds the active act of assigning falsehood. The pair therefore moves from failed orientation to maintained repudiation rather than listing two unrelated defects.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance supplies the failed course and functions as the diagnosis's first stage.
Attributing falsehood supplies an active verdict and functions as misorientation hardened into rejection.

changed_reading.after: A direct diagnosis of people whose failed orientation has become an active practice of declaring the disclosed claim false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first focus root can image hiddenness or loss, while the second names contradiction or false attribution.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired labels permit an epistemic shortcut: what is no longer locatable or visible is treated as unreal, then declared false.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness supplies absence from view and functions as the condition mistakenly equated with nonexistence.
Loss supplies failure to locate a thing and functions as the mistaken inference that it cannot be recovered.
Contradiction of truth supplies the negative verdict placed upon what has disappeared from view.

changed_reading.before: Error and denial are independent faults.
changed_reading.after: The addressees convert absence from their field of recovery into evidence that the promised reality is false.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated companionship and a shared side turn the plural address from an aggregate into an affiliation. Misorientation and denial become a company-defining position sustained by belonging and enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Deviation supplies the shared orientation by which the addressed company is characterized.
False attribution supplies the collective stance that stabilizes the company's identity.
Companionship supplies durable association and functions as the social carrier of the shared stance.
Enclosure from multiple sides supplies a bounded grouping and functions as the cohort's containing frame.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Lost orientation joined to active falsification.** `ض ل ل` **B001** supplies going astray from guidance and aim; `ك ذ ب` **B002** supplies declaring something false. The paired vocatives diagnose both navigational failure and speech-act. **Abductive move:** I infer that denial sustains misdirection, while the packet does not state which causes which. **Reading change:** the addressees are characterized by a coupled failure of direction and truth-recognition.

2. **Those who treated the hidden as lost.** `ض ل ل` **B002** supplies being hidden or disappearing and **B003** losing something. Their question about dust, bones, and ancestors assumed disappeared bodies could not return. **Abductive move:** I infer that their falsification rests on confusing invisibility with irretrievable loss. **Reading change:** “astray” also exposes an error about hidden matter.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The reversed order `المكذبين الضالين` at 56:92 prevented a single causal hierarchy and exposed denial and straying as mutually reinforcing.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Misorientation and active falsification are diagnosed as distinct cooperating failures.** `ض ل ل` (B001, deviation from guidance and aim) is apposed to `ك ذ ب` (B001, falsehood and declaring false). Ayat 46–50 show the persistent claim and its answer; ayat 52–56 spell out the provision awaiting those addressed. The packet supplies one root for lost direction and another for an asserted verdict against truth; I infer that error became culpable by being defended as a denial. neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiye gerçekleşmemiş bir eylem yüklenince bu iddiayı yalanlama bağlamında iki alan kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğruluk hakkında verilen hükümdür; komşu dal ise gerçekleşmemiş belirli bir eylemin kişiye isnat edilmesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir kalıbı zorunluluk bildirme ve bir işi yapmaya yöneltme anlamlarıyla açıklar. Bu anlamın yalan söylemeyle doğrudan bir bileşeni yoktur ve yalnız söz konusu kalıp içinde geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, belirli kalıbın 'sana düşer, onu yap' anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yalın köke genel bir zorunluluk veya özendirme anlamı vermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen kalıplaşmış söyleyişi açıklar; zorunluluk ve yöneltme anlamları yalın biçime taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir kalıp içinde, bir şeyin kişiye düşen bir yükümlülük olduğunu bildirmek veya kişiyi onu yapmaya yöneltmektir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Söyleyiş yoluyla muhatabı işi üstlenmeye çağırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalıplaşmış bir çağrı ve yükümlülük bildirimidir; komşu dal dışsal bir hüküm veya güçle bağlayıcılık kurma işlemidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi savaş hamlesindeki iki karşıt kalıbı birlikte verir: olumlu biçim hamlede durma, geri çekilme veya korkaklık; olumsuz biçim ise durmadan ilerleyip vuruşa ulaşmadır. Dalın kimliği bu kutuplu kalıp düzenine uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız saldırı hamlesi bağlamında ve olumlu-olumsuz biçimlerin karşıtlığıyla geçerlidir; genel yalan veya genel cesaret anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım savaş hamlesine bağlı iki kalıbı korur; duraksama ve kararlılıkla ilerleme anlamları yalın biçime genellenmez.

facets.statement: Olumlu kalıp, saldırıya geçtikten sonra durmayı, geri kalmayı veya korkaklık göstermeyi bildirir.
Olumsuz kalıp, saldırganın durmadan ilerleyerek vuruşa kadar hamleyi sürdürdüğünü bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar saldırı hamlesini sürdürmeme ile korkaklık arasında bağ kurar; olumsuz kalıp ise durmayıp vuruşa kadar ilerleme anlamını verir.

facets.statement: Kişi, belirtilen işi yapmadan önce beklemez veya oyalanmaz.
